scope: Public Tier 0 Tensor/device execution primitives and Tier 1 training-critical computation/lifecycle APIs
oracle_policy: PyTorch is primary for numerical and training semantics; deterministic contract tests cover engine-only execution and lifecycle truth.

entries.operation: construction, copy/move, clone, dtype and metadata
entries.contract: Checked shape/byte ownership with stable dtype, logical shape, copy and move semantics.
entries.supported: rank 0-4 ArrayFire tensors; Float32, Float64, Int32, Int64, UInt8
entries.oracle: PyTorch tensor construction plus engine ownership invariants

entries.operation: ReadData, MutableData and compatibility Data host boundaries
entries.contract: ReadData preserves device state; MutableData invalidates device state; successful guarded compute must not use Data.
entries.oracle: engine ownership and host-sync trace contract
gaps: remaining legacy compatibility Data audit outside the guarded training manifest

entries.operation: GetSemanticArray, SetFromSemanticArray and rank-aware ArrayFire layout conversion
entries.contract: Logical row-major rank-2/rank-3 semantics are preserved without device-to-host conversion.
entries.supported: rank 1-4; explicit semantic adapters for rank 2 and 3
entries.oracle: PyTorch logical layout plus zero-host-sync trace

entries.operation: reshape, view, squeeze, unsqueeze and flatten
entries.contract: Element order and count match PyTorch; invalid dimensions and products fail before compute.
entries.supported: public Tensor rank and dtype domain

entries.operation: transpose and permute
entries.contract: Logical dimensions and row-major values match PyTorch.
entries.supported: rank 0-4 and all Tensor dtypes on ArrayFire; explicit compatibility fallback above rank 4
entries.execution: ArrayFire device-to-device through rank 4; declared native CPU compatibility fallback above rank 4

entries.operation: At/Set typed indexing, Slice and IndexSelect
entries.contract: Positive and negative dimensions, positive slice steps, clamped bounds, empty outputs and selected value order match PyTorch; IndexSelect additionally preserves the declared CyxWiz negative-index extension after normalization.
entries.supported: rank 1-4 Slice/IndexSelect for all Tensor dtypes on ArrayFire; rank 1-4 typed scalar access; explicit compatibility fallback above rank 4
entries.oracle: PyTorch 2.10 plus explicit CyxWiz negative-IndexSelect and bounded scalar-access contracts
entries.execution: ArrayFire device-to-device Slice/IndexSelect through rank 4; declared native CPU compatibility fallback above rank 4; bounded At/Set are explicit host boundaries

entries.operation: Cat, Stack, Split and Chunk
entries.contract: Positive and negative axes, row-major ordering, scalar stack, PyTorch (0,) Cat identity, zero-sized split sections, empty dimensions, partial final chunks and invalid shapes match PyTorch within the declared same-dtype domain.
entries.supported: all Tensor dtypes: Cat ranks 1-4, Stack input ranks 0-3, and Split/Chunk ranks 1-4 on ArrayFire; explicit compatibility fallback for higher output ranks
entries.execution: ArrayFire device-to-device Cat/Stack through output rank 4; Split/Chunk delegate to resident Slice; declared native CPU compatibility fallback above rank 4

entries.operation: Sum, Mean, Max, Min, Prod, Var and Std; global and axis reductions
entries.contract: Global and axis shape, negative dimensions, keepdim, correction, dtype, empty and invalid-domain behavior match the selected PyTorch semantic variant.
entries.supported: all public Tensor dtypes at ranks 0-4 on ArrayFire; explicit compatibility fallback for ranks above 4
entries.execution: ArrayFire device-to-device reductions through rank 4 with zero compute host sync; declared native CPU compatibility fallback above rank 4 and pre-compute rejection in strict mode

entries.operation: tensor/scalar arithmetic, Pow, Sqrt, Exp, Log, Abs, Sign, Clip and negation
entries.contract: Broadcasting, dtype, finite/extreme behavior and element order match PyTorch within declared tolerance.
entries.supported: Float32, Float64, Int32, Int64 and UInt8 across public arithmetic and unary APIs; ArrayFire ranks 0-4 and declared rank-above-4 native compatibility
entries.execution: ArrayFire device-to-device through rank 4 with zero compute host sync; declared native CPU compatibility fallback above rank 4 and pre-compute rejection in strict mode

entries.operation: comparisons and logical operators
entries.contract: Zero/non-zero truth and UInt8 mask values follow the public Tensor contract.
entries.oracle: PyTorch with explicit UInt8 result adaptation

entries.operation: IsBroadcastable, BroadcastShape, BroadcastTo and Expand
entries.contract: Right-aligned broadcasting and invalid-shape rejection match PyTorch.

entries.operation: Zeros, Ones, Random, RandomSeeded and RangeN
entries.contract: Shape/dtype are exact; RandomSeeded replays the declared CyxWiz stream for a fixed seed.
entries.oracle: engine deterministic replay; distribution checks against PyTorch concepts, not identical RNG streams

entries.operation: Dot and BatchMatMul
entries.contract: Logical matrix/batch axes, shapes, dtype and values match PyTorch matmul semantics for supported ranks.
entries.supported: implementation-defined rank-1/2 Dot and batched matmul domain

entries.operation: device discovery and exact activation
entries.contract: Requested and effective backend/device remain distinct; exact activation validates execution and never relabels another backend.
entries.oracle: ArrayFire runtime identity plus engine contract
gaps: complete CPU-accelerator-CPU matrix on each installed backend

entries.operation: ExecutionDeviceContext capture, immutable bind and active-run mutation gate
entries.contract: One context is bound before compute and preserves requested/effective identity, generation and fallback policy for the run.
gaps: active-run mutation/defer assertion across GUI boundary

entries.operation: native CPU fallback compatibility and strict policies
entries.contract: Every attempt records operation/reason/backend/context/policy; strict mode rejects before native compute; ArrayFire CPU is not native fallback.
gaps: public-surface audit for unclassified direct CPU branches

entries.operation: host synchronization attribution and bounded output
entries.contract: Every device-to-host materialization has category, operation, shape, dtype, layout, backend and byte count.

entries.operation: Linear with bias, float32 forward/input-gradient/mean parameter-gradient
entries.contract: Forward is input @ weight^T + bias; input gradient is unreduced; parameter gradients are mean-reduced over batch.
entries.oracle: PyTorch fixture with explicit CyxWiz parameter-gradient reduction
entries.execution: ArrayFire-first; strict AF CPU path proven

entries.operation: Dense wrapper forward/backward and activation composition
entries.contract: Dense preserves Linear parameter semantics and applies the configured activation exactly once.
entries.execution: ArrayFire-first where component operations support it

entries.operation: FlattenLayer and FlattenModule forward/backward
entries.contract: Forward matches torch.nn.Flatten without value reordering; backward accepts only the exact cached output shape/dtype and restores the cached input shape.
entries.supported: rank >= 2, configured start_dim through the final dimension, and Float32/Float64/Int32/Int64/UInt8 payload preservation
entries.execution: strict ArrayFire-resident cross-rank reshape with zero native fallback or host synchronization on ArrayFire CPU, every installed CUDA/OpenCL device, and oneAPI device 1; oneAPI device 0 is rejected through the isolated route-qualification boundary
gaps: installed oneAPI device 0 provider/runtime repair: igc64.dll raises access violation 0xC0000005 during device input creation; rerun isolated qualification after driver/plugin update

entries.operation: DropoutLayer and DropoutModule training and evaluation modes
entries.contract: Probability is inclusive [0,1]; evaluation and p=0 are exact identity; p=1 is exact zero; Float32 training applies inverted-dropout scaling and backward reuses the mask owned by the successful training forward even if the current mode changes.
entries.supported: all Tensor dtypes for identity paths; Float32 for stochastic training
entries.oracle: Generated PyTorch 2.10 forward/backward boundary and distribution fixtures plus same-backend CyxWiz seed replay
entries.execution: strict ArrayFire-resident CPU, CUDA, OpenCL and qualified oneAPI routes; declared native CPU compatibility fallback
gaps: installed oneAPI device 0 Intel provider/runtime repair and exact-route requalification

entries.operation: ReLU, LeakyReLU, ELU, GELU, Swish/SiLU, Sigmoid, Tanh, Mish, Hardswish and SELU forward/backward
entries.contract: Forward and analytical input gradient match the corresponding PyTorch operation, including boundary points and finite extremes.
entries.execution: mixed; ArrayFire path must be audited per activation

entries.operation: Softmax forward/backward by axis
entries.contract: Stable normalization and Jacobian-vector product match PyTorch for the selected axis.

entries.operation: PReLU forward/input-gradient/learned-alpha gradient
entries.contract: Input and alpha gradients match PyTorch with the declared scalar/channel parameter form.

entries.operation: MSE, L1 and SmoothL1 forward/backward across reductions
entries.contract: Elementwise loss, reduction denominator and input gradient match PyTorch.

entries.operation: CrossEntropy index/soft targets, reductions, weights, ignore_index and label smoothing
entries.contract: Stable logits semantics, reduction denominator and prediction gradient match PyTorch exactly for each declared target form.
entries.supported: rank-1/2/3 class-last Float32 logits; Int32/Int64 indices or Float32 probability targets; None/Mean/Sum, class weights, ignore_index, and label smoothing
entries.execution: rank-1/2/3 index/soft matrix proven strict and device-resident on ArrayFire CPU with no native fallback

entries.operation: NLLLoss and FocalLoss forward/backward
entries.contract: Target indexing, weighting, focusing exponent, reduction and gradient match PyTorch/reference semantics.
entries.oracle: PyTorch where available; explicit reference for unsupported API differences

entries.operation: BCE, BCEWithLogits and KLDiv forward/backward
entries.contract: Probability/logit interpretation, pos_weight, log_target, reduction and gradients match PyTorch with finite extreme behavior.

entries.operation: SoftDice, Tversky and Jaccard forward/backward
entries.contract: Smoothing, alpha/beta, reduction and gradients follow the declared equations.

entries.operation: CosineEmbedding, Triplet and Contrastive forward/backward
entries.contract: Distance, label, margin, reduction and gradients match the declared PyTorch variants.

entries.operation: SGD base and momentum update
entries.contract: Step ordering, persistent momentum state, update count, exact state continuation and supported decay semantics match the declared PyTorch configuration.
entries.supported: Float32 named parameter maps; exposed learning-rate/momentum options
entries.execution: ArrayFire-first with an explicit momentum-correct native CPU fallback

entries.operation: Adam and NAdam first/multiple steps and state
entries.contract: Moments, bias correction, epsilon placement, update count and continuation match PyTorch.

entries.operation: AdamW decoupled decay, moments and continuation
entries.contract: Decoupled weight decay occurs before Adam update; moments, bias correction, epsilon and update count match PyTorch.
entries.execution: first-step parameter update proven strict on ArrayFire CPU

entries.operation: RMSprop, AdaGrad and Adadelta updates/state
entries.contract: Accumulator, momentum, epsilon, step and update semantics match the selected PyTorch configurations.

entries.operation: LAMB trust-ratio update and state
entries.contract: Moments, bias correction, weight decay, norms, trust ratio and update count match an independent reference.

entries.operation: StepLR, ExponentialLR, CosineAnnealingLR, ReduceLROnPlateau, LinearWarmupLR, OneCycleLR and LRWarmup
callers: public backend API; engine scheduler nodes are explicitly unsupported
entries.contract: Learning-rate sequence, epoch/step ordering, reset, plateau patience and warmup boundaries match the declared PyTorch semantics.
entries.execution: host control state; parameter updates remain backend-resident

entries.operation: confusion matrix, classification report, binary metrics, ROC/AUC and PR/AP
entries.contract: Thresholding, class decisions, denominators, averaging and curve integration match sklearn/PyTorch reference behavior.
entries.execution: training classification decisions accumulate device-resident correct/valid counts with bounded reporting readback; broader evaluation remains host-vector

entries.operation: MSE, RMSE, MAE, R-squared, MAPE and max-error evaluation
entries.contract: Full-dataset denominators and degenerate-target behavior match sklearn.
entries.supported: double host vectors; TrainingExecutor Float32 batches

entries.operation: normal completion and exact epoch/callback counts
entries.contract: A run configured for N epochs executes exactly N unless a distinct terminal reason occurs; status is completed/completed_all_epochs.

entries.operation: validation-plateau early stopping independent of best-checkpoint saving
entries.contract: Patience is evaluated whenever enabled, with or without save_best_checkpoint; terminal reason and last executed epoch remain exact.

entries.operation: plugin stop and user cancellation
entries.contract: Plugin stop is early_stopped/plugin_requested_early_stop; user stop is cancelled/user_cancelled; neither is completed, and cancellation while paused cannot release the wait into another batch or optimizer update.
entries.supported: Arrow, Parquet, external IBatcher, sequence ISequenceBatcher, and legacy DatasetHandle TrainingExecutor runs

entries.operation: preflight and runtime failure terminal truth
entries.contract: Preflight rejects before any batch; runtime exception records failed with non-empty reason across every reporting surface.

entries.operation: best-checkpoint save/restore and active-model provenance
entries.contract: Last executed/stopping epoch is immutable run history; restored checkpoint epoch/path and active-model provenance are separate fields. Version 1.0 model parameters preserve shape, dtype and exact payload bytes for every supported Tensor dtype; invalid payloads fail before active-model mutation.
entries.supported: checkpoint-enabled runs and version 1.0 Float32, Float64, Int32, Int64 and UInt8 model-parameter payloads

entries.operation: batch, epoch, validation, completion and metric-sampling cadence
entries.contract: Callback counts and validation-finalization rules are exact; reporting cadence cannot alter optimizer or epoch semantics.
entries.execution: run control and bounded scalar reporting

entries.operation: gradient accumulation, optimizer step counts and final partial flush
entries.contract: The user-visible and compiled grad_accum_steps contract is 1-100000; mean-reduced accumulation uses the loss's true semantic denominator, including CrossEntropy class weights and ignored targets, while sum-reduced gradients add without averaging; accumulated gradients, reported epoch loss and final parameters match an equivalent PyTorch effective batch; partial final windows flush exactly once.

entries.operation: train/dev/test split, full/partial batches, drop_last, shuffle and sampler seed
entries.contract: Partitions are isolated; sample membership, batch counts, final partial behavior and seeded order are deterministic.
entries.supported: Arrow, Parquet, image, audio, Arrow-backed Text, Sequence, and external batcher configurations
entries.oracle: deterministic index fixtures and PyTorch sampler semantics where applicable

entries.operation: pause/resume
entries.contract: Pause/resume neither duplicates nor skips batches, callbacks, or optimizer updates; cancellation while paused performs no subsequent work; engine scheduler nodes remain explicitly unsupported.
entries.supported: Arrow, Parquet, external IBatcher, sequence ISequenceBatcher, and legacy DatasetHandle cooperative control
